[[File:Monkfish detail.png|left|100px]]
'''Monkfish''' is a type of [[fish]] that restores 16 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten.  

It can be obtained by cooking [[raw monkfish]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], requiring level 62 [[Cooking]] and granting 150 [[experience]] when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a [[burnt monkfish]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 90 on ranges and level 92 on fires. 

When eaten, the message {{Mes|You eat the monkfish. 
It heals some health.}} is displayed. 

While the [[Swan Song]] quest must be completed to fish raw monkfish, there is no such requirement for cooking them. 

Catching and cooking a monkfish is a requirement for the [[hard Western Provinces Diary]].
